BLOCKED: the list index can't be added to the error path without a change to `winnow-grammar`. I built nothing and committed nothing. Report: /home/user/Nikaia/docs/briefs/tools/j6-1019-error-path.md.report.md

- **Probe:** I ran the brief's probe on the current compiler (843e716). The failure is in list element 1, but no element frame appears between `Value__Contact` and `Value__Vec_Contact_`.
- **Cause:** the backend's repetitions number an error with an element frame (`item N`) only when it is a Backtrack, never when it is a Cut. Every `members[S]` failure is a Cut, and so is the probe's `"{" =>`. So `$.contacts[1]` can't be shown in step 1 or step 2.
- **Other routes I ruled out:**
  - An `item N` frame doesn't say which repetition it came from (`digit+` inside an element also pushes one).
  - The macro inlines `__nikaia_list`, so the list has no frame of its own to mark it.
  - A frame's name is fixed when the code is generated, so it can't carry a running index.
  - A hand-written `extern rule` turns every error into a Backtrack.
- **What the backend would need (architect decision):** either (a) repetitions that also number a Cut error, plus a way to mark the list's repetition; or (b) a pattern that pushes a frame built at run time onto a failing error, Backtrack or Cut.
- **Field names need no backend change:** a marker rule per field, read and dropped in `nikaia_std::grammar`, would carry them. I left that half unbuilt on purpose, because a path without its indices (`$.contacts.mail`) would be wrong.
- **Disk:** `target/nikaia-project-tests` is 3.6 GB, 11 GB is free on `/`, and this run created no new cache entries.
